# Update audio documentation

## Goal

Update the game's audio documentation to describe the ToneForge-based baked-asset pipeline, replacing the "zero external audio assets" stance and the procedural-synthesis descriptions.

As the game's developer, I want the docs to describe the ToneForge pipeline accurately, so future audio work starts from the shipped design.

## Scope

- Update GDD §7.3 to state the baked-WAV + ToneForge methodology, the thruster-hum runtime shim exception, and the build-time generation requirement.
- Preserve the SFX event catalogue, per-enemy audio character and player audio character tables, re-pointing synthesis references to recipe names where available.
- Update `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` per-enemy audio ownership to reference ToneForge recipe slugs.
- Update the audio-directory tree note to describe `public/audio/sfx/` and `scripts/build-audio.sh`.
- Record the recipe-to-cue mapping in the docs (or link to it) so docs and code cannot drift.

## Acceptance Criteria

- GDD §7.3 describes the ToneForge baked-asset pipeline and no longer mandates "zero external audio assets".
- GDD §7.3 documents the thruster-hum runtime shim as the single runtime-synthesised exception.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` references ToneForge recipe names for per-enemy audio.
- The audio-directory tree note describes `public/audio/sfx/` and the build script.
- Documentation links the recipe-to-cue mapping so it is discoverable.
- No documentation still claims procedural Web Audio synthesis is the shipping approach.

## Dependencies

- Cue-to-recipe mapping and unused-cue audit.
- Author game-specific ToneForge recipes.

## Deliverables

- Updated `docs/Game Design Document.md` §7.3.
- Updated `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` audio sections.
- Updated audio-directory tree note.

## Key Files

- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — §7.3 Audio Direction.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` — per-enemy audio ownership.

## Documented test matrix (parent AC8)

The reusable fixtures in `src/test/powerUpEffectFixtures.ts` back the following case matrix. Each row names the fixture helper used and the parent-AC case it covers.

### P3 multi-hit absorption
| Case | Fixture | Assertion |
|---|---|---|
| Absorb count per upgrade level L (0..3) | `createEffectRegistry` + `activateEffectAtUpgradeLevel({P3}, L)` | `shieldAbsorptionsRemaining()` equals `resolvePowerUpAtLevel('P3', L).shieldAbsorptions`; exactly L hits absorbed then popped |
| Level-0 backward compatibility (single hit) | same, L=0 | first `tryAbsorbShield()` true, second false |
| Refresh-not-stack on re-collect | same fixture, re-collect | remaining reset to the resolved count, never added |
| Level persists after bubble expiry | same fixture + `tick` | `store.getUpgradeLevel('P3')` unchanged |
| Run-scoped reset | same fixture + `reset()` | remaining cleared |

### P4 ranged periodic bomb
| Case | Fixture | Assertion |
|---|---|---|
| Field pickup = single pulse, consumed | `StubEnemyBullet` field | one ranged clear, no persistent state |
| Permanent = immediate + interval pulses | `activateEffectAtUpgradeLevel({P4}, L, { permanent: true })` + `tick` | pulses every `1/bombFrequency`, never expires |
| Per-level range | `store.stats('P4').bombRange` | larger level → larger cleared radius |
| Reset semantics | same fixture + `reset()` | permanent flag + pulse timer cleared |
| Ranged clear game↔gym parity | `bootRangedClearScene` + `expectRangedClear` | only in-range bullets destroyed, identical shared code |

### Range oracle
`isWithinBlastRange(x, y, cx, cy, range)` defines "within range" as distance ≤ range (inclusive); `partitionByBlastRange` and `expectRangedClear` assert a clear against that oracle without duplicating any scene setup.

### Choice-summary truthfulness
| Case | Fixture | Assertion |
|---|---|---|
| P3/P4 summaries promise only applied deltas | model fixtures (F3) | `summarisePowerUpLevelChange` no longer defers P3/P4 |

### Model axes (F3)
| Case | Fixture | Assertion |
|---|---|---|
| bombRange/bombFrequency specs, monotonic + clamped | `createSeededLevelStore` | resolver output at base/cap; `bombCharges` removed |
